verdict.rationale: Turso documents Embedded Replicas, which keep a local read replica of a cloud database: reads are served locally and writes go to the cloud primary and are reflected back. The durability page cites 11-nines data durability, and marketing says data is "Replicated." However, nothing in the pack describes high-availability architecture, failover behavior, or adding server-side read replicas across regions. missing for 10: documented HA/failover behavior (primary loss, promotion, RTO/RPO), server-side multi-region read replica provisioning, availability SLA, independent corroboration of replica/failover reliability.
